other_conditions: The scheme is applicable to industrial units operating in the Garment, Apparel & Made‑ups, and Technical Textile sectors (including Composite Units).
Workers must be domiciled in Gujarat and be registered under the EPF scheme.
The industrial unit must submit its application within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹5,000 per female worker and ₹4,000 per male worker per month for Garment/ Apparel/ Made‑ups (including Composite Units), and up to ₹3,000 per female worker and ₹2,000 per male worker per month for Technical Textile (including Composite Units).
